purpose: Bo query THU CONG (khong phai sinh tu real-search-history hay engine gia lap) danh cho demo khach hang - minh hoa su khac biet ro giua As-Is (he thong hien tai tren lottemart.vn) va Actual (he thong dev-gateway dang test). File nay KHONG co du lieu Expected (khong co search_results) - mo bang compare_results.py roi doi toggle 'So sanh' sang 'As-Is <-> Actual' de xem, panel Expected se hien trong/TBD vi khong ap dung cho file nay.
howToUse: 1. Lay Actual: python scripts/automation/export_actual_search_results.py --env dev --batch demo_asis_vs_actual --no-auth (hoi lai auth mode truoc khi chay that)

2. Compare (KHONG truyen --no-asis-fetch - rule rieng cho file demo nay): python scripts/automation/compare_results.py --expected SmartSearch/test_data/json/batches/NSG_ExpectedData_demo_asis_vs_actual_20260831.json --actual <file actual vua export>. Vi file nay khong co Expected, moi scenario deu qualify nguong <=50% nen se TU DONG goi he thong As-Is that cho bat ky query nao chua co trong cache (khong can hoi lai moi lan, chi ap dung rieng cho file demo nho, tu chon nay - khac voi batch that lon van phai --no-asis-fetch/hoi truoc).
3. Trong compare_report.html, doi dropdown 'So sanh' o dau trang sang 'As-Is <-> Actual' de xem đung so sanh can demo.
4. Co them query moi de demo: append scenario NSG-DEMO-00xx moi vao chinh file nay (dung tao file moi).
